run_qmix_sc2_training: run StarCraft 2 multi-agent QMIX training with RLlib on a specified map
run_qmix_with_custom_iters: run QMIX training for a custom number of iterations using the --num-iters flag
run_qmix_with_custom_workers: run QMIX training with a custom number of Ray workers using the --num-workers flag
run_qmix_on_custom_map: run QMIX training on a custom StarCraft 2 map using the --map-name flag
review_env_creator: review the env_creator function that groups homogeneous agents and creates observation and action spaces
